tei:div.tei:p: sa skyong sde dge'i rgyal rabs mdor bsdus baiḍūr+ya'i do shal bzhugs/ (144)sar gnas byang sems bstan skyong phyir// sa skyong rgyal po'i tshul bzung nas// sa kun byams pas skyong ba yi// sa spyod rnams kyang bsngags pa'i yul/ mdo khams bod chen po'i ljongs su rgyal bstan ris su ma chad pa gtsug tu bkur ba'i sbyin bdag skye rgu mtha' yas pa la phan bde rtsol ba'i mnga' bdag 'gran zla dang bral ba chos rgyal sde dge zhes grags pa'i gdung rabs kyi rtsa ba lha las babs pa'i mgar gnam tsha 'brug ces pa'i sras brgyud bzhi pa chos rgyal srong btsan gyi blon po mgar stong btsan gyis yul bzung*/ de'i sras brgyud rim par byon pa'i lnga pa khri gnyer khri lcags kyi brgyud pa las tshal pa khri dpon rnams byung*/ khri gnyer mched zla a mye dge ba dpal gyi sras lha rje byams pa dpal chos rgyal khri srong gi sku tshe'i smad la byon/ mdo khams su byon te 'dan gyi brag ra gling chen tu gdan chags pa nas gdung brgyud khams phyogs su byung*/ gdung rabs nyer brgyad par mgar chen ye shes bzang po'i sras bsod nams rin chen gyis 'gro mgon chos rgyal 'phags (145)pa'i gsol dpon gyi las ka bzung*/ gong ma se chen gan gyis 'ja' sa byin te chen po'i go sar bkod/ de'i dbon po tu rgu ru'i sras zla ba bzang po la gong ma mchod yon gyis sa dmar stong dpon gyi las ka gnang bas 'di phyin tu stong dpon du grags/ gdung rabs so bzhi pa bde chen bsod nams bzang po sa stod du sde dge'i mtshan thogs/ de nas rim par byon te da lta yan gdung rabs zhe bdun song*/ de la grub pa thob pa'i chos brgyud ni/ byams pa dpal sogs he ru ka dngos dang mtshungs pa'i shrī'i mtshan can bdun/ mgar dam pa chos sdings pa/ ru chos rdor pa/ sde dge grub thob kun dga' rgya mtsho gtso bor gyur pa'i grub pa brnyes pa dang rigs sngags nus pa'i mthu stobs can rnams zam ma chad par byon/

'jig rten skyong ba'i che brgyud ni/ sngar dus yongs su grags pa'i me nyag gi rgyal brgyud kyang 'di las byung bar grags shing*/ phyis tshal pa khri dpon/ spu bo phu lung sde pa sogs mnga' thang can mang du byung ba'i nang gses sa skyong sde dge ni gong smos bde chen gsod nams (146)bzang po ma yum 'das pa'i dge sgrub la tu sa dmar nas kaḥthog tu byon/ karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang*/ tu chos rdor pa gnyis kas sa stod phyogs su song na gnas bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbyibs yod pa zhig tu rim gyis dbang bsgyur nas brgyud pa je bzang du 'gro bar lung bstan pa bzhin du lcags rar byon/ gling chen po bdag drung gi nang blon mdzad/ de skabs sde dang bstan srid la shin tu dge bar bzung bas/ sde dge'i mtshan thogs pa ni gnam gyi lhas bsgrags pa'o/ de la sras bzhi byung ba'i gnyis pa bo thar skabs/ gling bdag drung pa'i zhal ngo dang gnyen srid bsdebs pa'i rin la zul rgyud kyi sa cha mi sde blangs/ dngul mdar pho brang btab/ dbu 'phang dar rgyas su bzhugs skabs grub chen thang stong rgyal po phebs/ srib pa'i klu btul/ mtsho'i steng ras gzan gyis bkab nas lha khang bzhengs/ srib dgon thog mar btab/ grub chen nas dgon ming la lhun grub steng*/ bo thar la bkra shis seng ge zhes pa'i mtshan btags/ de'i sras bla ma dpal ldan seng ges nyin ri'i phyogs su 'dus sde btsugs pas deng sang nyin dgon du grags/ mched zla rgyal mtshan 'bum (147)gyis sras brgyud sde dge kun dga' rin chen gyis bla brang gi lha khang bzhengs/ der bzhugs rnams la sde dge lha khang pa zhes grags/ gdung rabs brgyad pa lhun thub la sras drug byung ba'i gsum pa bla chen byams pa phun tshogs stobs kyi 'khor los bsgyur ba chen por gyur te/ 'di skabs gling dpon po nang tshan du gyes pa sogs sde shog re la dpon phran res bzung*/

lugs gnyis kyi khrims med pas 'og sde rnams kyang rang dpon la yid sun nas 'bangs gyen ldog kho na byung ba'i skabs bla chen 'di dang phyag mdzod kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpon blon nas ngan pa rnams cham la phab/ dman pa rnams mgo blangs/ rdzong sgo bco brgyad kyi rmang bting*/ mi sde nyi khri lnga stong mnga' zhabs su bsdus/ lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang bsam 'grub mthong grol chen mo gtsos ris med pa'i chos sde brgya rtsa lhag btab/ sga pa'i gser khral dang*/ 'ba' pa'i dngul khral blangs de skabs/ be ri rgyal pos bon po'i phyogs bzung nas/ khams phyogs kyi dge lugs gtsos bstan pa spyi'i dgrar gyur pa la gu shrī bstan 'dzin chos rgyal nas sde dge bla chen dpung grogs su (148)sbran te be ri rming med du bcom/ dpa' rtags su 'brog sde sbra thag 'then tshad sog pos bdag yul sde shing sgo btsugs tshad sde dge la byin pas 'bri chu pha ri'i sde rnams dang*/ tshur ri 'dan ma sogs 'di dus byung bar grags/ de mtshungs rgyal po mkha' 'gro byed spyod ma mkhas pas sog pos bcom pa'i dpung grogs byas pa'i dpa' dar la nyag gshis skor rnams byung*/ dbus gtsang gi khrims yig zhal lce bcu drug la dper byas nas khrims yig chen mo bzhag pas sde dge bla ma byams pa phun tshogs kyi khrims rgan ma zhes tshad 'jog rdzong mgo rnams kyi khral thog phyed ka re rdzong mgo so so dang 'brel ba'i dgon sde rnams su tshogs sgo'i gtong thebs su sbyor ba deng sang gi bar rgyun ma nyams pa yod/ 'di nas bzung sde dge'i khri rabs kyi dbu 'dzin pa dang*/ gdung rgyud re re las med pa'i dus ma gtogs khri 'dzin bla ma kho nas mdzad pa'i srol tshugs/ khri rabs gnyis pa kun dga' phun tshogs/ gsum pa che mchog rnams kyi skabs thugs rgyud 'jam/ bzhi pa khri chen sangs rgyas bstan pa lugs gnyis kyi (149)mkhyen stobs dang sku bsod 'gran zla bral bas bla chen gyi dus ltar chab 'bangs rnams mnga' 'og tu bsdus/

ris med kyi gtsug lag khang dang chos sde mang po nyams gso gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ rgyal khams la bka' khrims drang pos phan bdes khyab pas kun gyis smon pa byung*/ khri rabs lnga pa bla ma bsod nams phun tshogs chos srid mkhyen rgya mdzad pa de dang mtshungs pa la byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pas cung 'jam ches 'dug zer ba byung*/ 'di skabs rgyal po lha bzang gis kho rang gi bu rgyal dbang drug pa'i sprul sku yin rgyur byas nas mtshan ye shes rgya mtshor btags te khri 'don byas/ li thang du rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs pa thos nas er khe ju nang dpon g.yog mang po bkrong ba la btang ba'i skabs gnyer chen 'bir lugs dpung dang bcas pa btang nas rgyal dbang dpon slob rgyal khab 'dir spyan drangs nas zhabs tog bsnyen bkur zhus/ rgya bod kyi gtsug rgyan du bkod pas gzhung dga' ldan pho brang dang 'brel zab che ba 'di nas byung*/ rgyal dbang bdun pa'i bka' shog she bam chen mo gnang (150)ba la'ang*/ sde dge bla dpon 'di nged na tshod chung dus drin bzo byas pa che bas kho rang tshang ma zad sde dge'i mi ser yin nges rung*/ phyin ja khral gtsang chag dgos tshul sogs bdag rkyen chen mo gnang ba'i rgyun da lta'ang gnas bzhin par snang*/ khri rabs drug pa chos rgyal bstan pa tshe ring ni/ sngon chos rgyal mes dbon rnams kyi rjes su bsnyegs pa'i chos srid gnyis ka'i mdzad pa shin tu rgya che bar yongs su grags shing phyag rjes da lta mig mthong du yod pa 'di la smos ma dgos shing*/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen mo g.yung cing gis sog po o rod rgyal po la dgongs phog byung nas ming med du brlags/ mdo khams phyogs kyi sde dpon khod snyoms la tsi'u tā lo ye btang skabs mnga' 'og 'dir rku jag khram gsum med pa'i rgyal khrims tshad thub sngar nas yod pa dang*/ lhag par chos rgyal 'di nyid kyi rnam dkar mdzad pa 'gran zla dang bral ba gong ma chen mo'i gser snyan du dwangs pas/

mdo khams smad phyogs kyi dpon po che shos mtshon byed du gsan yu pa'i tham ga gan gos yug brgya/ dngul srang stong (151)phrag nan phyin/ rdza rgyud 'brog sde gtsos mi ser mang po lha 'bangs su rtsal/ tā lo ye nas 'dam sog la skya bo man chad rang dbang bsgyur chog pa'i bka' phebs pa sogs lung dang lag rtags 'gran zla med pas phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal bar gyur/ rdzong sgo sngar yod rnams kyi steng du rdzong 'og nyi shu rtsa lnga sogs 'di dus byung*/ de tsam gyis chog shes par mdzad nas gzhan sde chab 'og tu bcug pa sogs ni nam yang mi mdzad kyang yul 'khor byams pas skyong ba la shugs kyis dad pas lho byang 'brog sde gtsos dpon rigs rnams nas kyang 'di phyi'i skyabs gnas zhu ba kho na byung*/ lhun grub steng gtsos gtsug lag khang gsar bzhengs rnying gsos mang po/ mchod thebs rgya che ba/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten khyad 'phags du ma/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur ro cog dang*/ bstan 'gyur pod nyi shu/ gzhan pusti drug cu skor gyi spar khyad 'phags gsar brkos/ dpal spungs thub bstan chos 'khor gling gtsug lag khang dge 'dun sde bcas gsar bkod sogs bstan 'gror phan bde'i mdzad pa bsam gyis mi khyab bo/ khri rabs bdun pa bla chen (152)phun tshogs bstan pa ni/ chos blon rig pa can slar byon pa lta bu'i mtshan gyi snyan pas kyang sa chen 'dar nus pa'i las dbang btsan po'i stobs dang ldan pas chos ldan gyi rgyal srid yab mes ltar bskyangs/ yab rje chos kyi rgyal po'i rten bzhengs 'phro lus pa spyi dang*/ bstan 'gyur pusti ny-is brgya dang brgyad/ rig gnas skor sogs pusti sum cu skor gyis spar gsar du bzhengs/ khri rabs brgyad pa sa skyong blo gros rgyal mtshan ni/ phyi dgra la blo shed che/ nang mi la thugs brtses gzigs/ mnga' 'bangs la byams pas bskyangs/ rgyal khams mi bde ba'i gzhi cung zad byed pa la'ang nyes chad 'phral du btang bas mnga' zhabs su bde skyid kyi nyi ma shar ba byung*/

sku gsung thugs rten khyad par du 'phags pa bcas grangs mang ba dang*/ rnying ma'i mdzod bdun/ mdo sde nges don pod drug zhu chen bka' 'bum pod bcu gcig rig gnas sogs pusti lnga bcu lhag pa'i spar gsar brkos/ gtsug lag khang mang po gsar bzhengs rnying gso'i phyag rjes rgya che zhing*/ las dbang btsan po'i rang shugs kyis gzhan sde khas drag dpung chen mang po 'bad (153)rtsol ma dgos pa mnga' 'og tu 'dus pa byung*/ khri rabs dgu pa sa dbang sde dga' bzang po ni/ sa skya pa 'jam mgon kun dga' blo gros kyis ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi sprul par lung bstan cing mtshan btags bstsal yang*/ gdung brgyud gcig pur song gshis rgyal srid skyong dgos pa byung bas sku tshe yun du ma brtan par de ma nyid du gshegs/ ma yum sga rje dpon mo tshe dbang lha mos khrims srid yun ring bskyangs/ mnga' thang sngar ltar rgyas/ rnying ma rgyud 'bum pod nyer lnga/ rig 'dzin chen po 'jigs med gling pa'i bka' 'bum pod dgu'i spar gtsos rten bzhengs dang phyag rjes rgya che/ khri rabs bcu pa tshe dbang rdo rje rig 'dzin ni/ gdung brgyud gcig pur song gshis/ sku gzhon nu'i skabs khyim thabs mdzad/ phyis rab tu byung nas bla chen gyi go sar bzhugs nas rgyal srid bskyangs/ dbang thang che zhing dbu rmog btsan pa byung*/ khri rabs bcu gcig pa dam tshig rdo rje ni/ rgyal khab mnga' 'bangs la byams brtse che zhing thugs dam nyams bzhes la gtso bor mdzad/ khri rabs bcu gnyis pa dpal (154)ldan 'chi med rtag pa'i rdo rje ni/ yab mes gong ma rnams dang thugs dgongs mdzad spyod mtshungs shing*/ o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pas bod rje lha sras mu tig btsad po'i rnam rol du rdo rje'i lung gis bsngags/ khri rabs bcu gsum pa lha sras ngag dbang 'jam dpal rin chen ni/ sku na phra dus nas mkhyen rab kyi rtsal kha rdzogs/

yab rje'i bka' 'brel bzhin rgyal srid la gces spras dang*/ 'khor 'bangs la byams brtses bskyangs/ yid srub 'phrul gyis mi brdzi ba'i blo gros dang mthu stobs rmad du byung*/ khri rabs bcu bzhi pa 'jigs med rdo rje seng ge ni/ chos srid gnyis ldan gyi mdzad phrin tshangs thig las drang shing*/ 'dzam gling rgyan gcig spar khang chos mdzod chen mo nyams gsos bla na ma mchis pa dang*/ snga 'gyur bla med gsang ba'i rgyud sde dkar chag bcas pusti nyer drug dus mig grangs ldan rin chen dang po dang gnyis pas bzhengs/ sku rten gser zangs 'ba' zhig las grub pa gsar bzhengs dang nyams gso sogs rnam dkar gyi mdzad phrin dbyar mtsho (155)ltar 'phel/ khri rabs bco lnga pa lha sras rin po che tshe dbang 'dud 'dul nya gang zla ba'i lang tsho gsar pa chos rgyal gong ma'i gser khrir phebs nas lo ngo gnyis tsam song zhing*/ dam pa'i rigs sad/ spobs pa'i mthu stobs rgyas/ bsod nams kyi stobs 'byor/ 'phags pa'i lung gis bsngags/ gzhan las khyad par 'phags pa'i rmad du byung ba'i ngo mtshar dgung lo drug gi thog tu gser khrir 'khod pas bstan 'gro ma lus pa'i dpal dang yon tan bye ba'i 'byung gnas gcig pur gyur pa nyid do/ rgyal bstan ris med sbyin bdag che// stobs btsan yul bzung rgyud pa mchog /mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal po yi// chos srid mi nyams dar rgyas shog / ces pa'ang sde dge nyag gshis dgon phu phan bde mi 'gyur gling du rnying btsun thub bstan chos kyi glang pos dge tshul slong gi sdom pa 'bogs zhor chu khyi zla 4 tshes 28 la bris pa dge legs 'phel// zhus so// //
